changelog:
- Added detailed Interactive Setup with conversational onboarding to create personalized workspace files based on user responses.
- Auto-detects missing core files; triggers setup flow if needed, bypassing manual menu steps for new users.
- Translates user feedback on tone, communication style, and boundaries into structured prompt instructions for SOUL.md.
- Generates AGENTS.md and TOOLS.md from concrete use cases and tool preferences shared by the operator, with live previews before writing.
- Immediately introduces and logs the operator’s first memory as a tutorial, and validates workspace files post-setup.
- Maintains alternative scaffold option for power users wanting default templates.
summary: Manage and optimize your OpenClaw training workspace -- scaffold files, generate skills, log training sessions, and validate workspace structure.
